interpretation_notes: Binary classification with HistGradientBoostingClassifier and native categorical handling on engineered features (arrival ordinal/dow, totals, ratios). Applied tune_when_n_train_supports_it: n=33680, GBM, no constraints — used a 3-config grid with 5-fold StratifiedKFold OOF AUC for selection; refit best config with 3-seed ensemble for the test predictions.
